Fields.Name: On / Off Gain
Fields.Description: How fast foot IK blends in and out.

Fields.Name: Ground Ascending Gain
Fields.Description: How fast a foot follows the ground up.

Fields.Name: Ground Descending Gain
Fields.Description: How fast a foot follows the ground down.

Fields.Name: Foot Planted Gain
Fields.Description: How fast a planted foot moves to the ground.

Fields.Name: Foot Raised Gain
Fields.Description: How fast a raised foot moves to the ground.

Fields.Name: Foot Locking Gain
Fields.Description: How strongly a planted foot is locked in place.

Fields.Name: Ankle Rotation Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the ankle rotates to the ground's slope.

Fields.Name: World From Model Feedback Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the character's height is corrected to keep the feet on the ground.

Fields.Name: Error Up / Down Bias
Fields.Description: Whether the height correction favours moving up or down (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Align World From Model Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the character tilts to match the ground.

Fields.Name: Hip Orientation Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the hips rotate to the ground.
